name: Cognitive Map Theory
citation: Tolman, E.C. (1948). Cognitive maps in rats and men. Psychological Review, 55(4), 189-208.
rejection_rationale: IS the SN (Spatial Navigation) framework itself — circular reduction. Cognitive mapping via hippocampal place cells, grid cells, and head direction cells constitutes the core of the SN framework. Reducing 'Cognitive Map Theory' to SN is tautological. Used directly as T1.
key_references: O'Keefe, J. & Nadel, L. (1978). The hippocampus as a cognitive map. Oxford University Press.

function_form.function_form: M(x) = {nodes: Lᵢ, edges: dᵢⱼ(metric), topology: Tᵢⱼ(connectivity)}

variables.M(x): Internal spatial representation of environment x

predictions: Distance estimates biased by number of intervening boundaries (+20%/boundary)
